name: com.where-tomorrow/where-tomorrow
title: Where Tomorrow
description: Where to live in Europe: cost, climate to 2035, safety and more for 13,000 places, sourced.

tools.name: find_places
tools.description: Look up places by name and get their ids. Searches the 85 cities and regions with full reports, the ~13,000 towns being verified and ~475,000 villages and towns in Europe. Use the id with get_place or compare_places.

query.description: A place name, or the start of one (accents optional).

tools.name: rank_places
tools.description: Rank places for someone's priorities, the way where-tomorrow.com ranks them. Each priority is 0 (does not matter) to 4 (matters most); leaving them all out ranks on the plain average. The match score reads the place's dimension scores against how each runs across Europe, then their weighted mean against how that mean runs across Europe at these priorities: 50 is Europe's middle, 80 or more about its top tenth. Optional limits drop places that miss them. Returns the best places with their scores, sources and dates, a link to each, and a chart image.

continent.description: Where to look. Europe is the region the site has launched; the other continents' cities are in preview. 'any' ranks them all.

country.description: Only one country, as its two-letter ISO code (PT, ES, DE).

eu_healthcare.description: Only places where EU citizens' public healthcare cover applies (EU, EEA, Switzerland).

max_monthly_cost_eur.description: Budget: a comfortable month for one person costs at most this many euros.

min_safety.description: Safety score at least this, 0 to 100 (homicide rate and political stability).

min_walkability.description: Walkability at least this, 0 to 100 (shops and services within a kilometre).

min_winter_c.description: Winters (December to February average) at least this warm, °C.

outlook_2035.description: Score on the outlook for 2035 (projected warming and heat; figures with no projection are held at today's) instead of today.

priorities.description: How much each dimension matters, 0 to 4. Absent counts as 0.

climate.description: Climate resilience: climate vulnerability and days reaching 30 °C, with projected warming to 2035.

community.description: Community fit: the share of residents born abroad.

cost.description: Cost of living: how affordable it is (price level and spending per person); higher scores are cheaper.

healthcare.description: Healthcare access: health spending, life expectancy and out-of-pocket costs.

internet.description: Internet: people online and broadband lines per 100 people (not speed).

safety.description: Safety and stability: homicide rate and political stability.

tax.description: Tax friendliness: income tax and social contributions on an average wage; higher scores tax less.

visa.description: Visa freedom: the share of the world's passports admitted without a visa (entry, not residence).

scope.description: 'areas': the cities and regions with full sourced reports. 'all': also every town and village we hold (mostly national figures plus their own climate and walkability).

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Every figure we hold for one place: its eight scores today and for 2035, its cost, winter, walkability, weather and taxes, and for a city or region with a report its detailed figures (rent, wages, life expectancy and more), each with its source and date. Get the id from find_places or rank_places.

tools.name: compare_places
tools.description: Two to four places side by side: their eight scores and their card figures, each with its source and date, a link to each place and a chart image. Get ids from find_places or rank_places.

outlook_2035.description: Compare the 2035 outlook instead of today.
